respuesta.razonamiento: WarnerMedia HBO's cloud linear playout architecture runs out of AWS US East 1. Linear master files stored in S3 are transferred to EC2 instances (running Evertz ORT software across 3 AZs with 10 channels each, supported by AutoScaling). The playout feeds flow via Direct Connect to on-premise locations: one path (the X chain) routes through the Techwood/CNN Center facility to the Atlanta (ATL) uplink satellite dish for affiliate distribution, while a BCP path routes directly to the Hudson Yards (NYC) uplink satellite dish. CloudFormation is omitted per Rule 7 as it is purely a deployment tool not involved in runtime traffic.

edges.notes: master files transferred to local EC2 instances running Evertz ORT
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow from S3 to EC2, and transcript: 'Once they are registered in Eberts Mediator, they then get transferred to the local EC2, which is running Eberts ORT software.'

edges.notes: playout stream sent as unicast signal across Direct Connect
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow from EC2 to Direct Connect, and transcript: 'Those files are played out using Eberts playtime. That play out goes via direct connect back to prem as a unicast signal.'

edges.notes: tertiary X chain path sent to on-prem changeover switch at Techwood / CNN Center
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow labeled X- from Direct Connect to TWD/CNN Center, and transcript: 'This path here, which I just drew, is what we call the X chain... tertiary path to air.'

edges.notes: signal compressed and sent to uplink for affiliate distribution
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow from TWD/CNN Center to ATL dish, and transcript: 'Then that gets taken and compressed and brought to the uplink for distribution to affiliates.'

edges.notes: BCP stream sends 8 channels to Hudson Yards uplink
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow labeled BCP from Direct Connect to NYC dish, and transcript: 'For the BCP solution, we go direct connect to Hudson Yards, and that is eight channels, and that also gets fed to an uplink.'
